clue.text: Falsely accused by FBI man about crash

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the second, placed outside it

parts.note: a FED is an American slang term for a federal agent such as an FBI officer
to ram something is to crash into it

explanation.surface: A federal agent pins the blame for a car crash on an innocent person.
explanation.definitionFit: To be framed is to be set up so that evidence wrongly points at you.

clue.text: Head of chemistry in wrong university department

indicators.note: in means this letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: faulty means wrong or defective

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: The head of chemistry works in the wrong department at the university.
explanation.definitionFit: A faculty is a group of related departments in a university.

clue.text: A grain found in oak

parts.note: corn is grain

explanation.surface: A seed grows on an oak tree.
explanation.definitionFit: An acorn is the nut, or seed, borne by the oak tree.

clue.text: Net adjustment by water board

indicators.note: adjustment suggests rearranging, so the word net is rearranged

parts.note: rain is falling water

explanation.surface: The water board makes a change to its net figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adjustment' rearranges NET into ENT; 'Water board' looks like a utility company, but the definition is 'board' in the sense of getting on a train.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrain is to get on a railway carriage, i.e. board it.

clue.text: Stick around at home like a dog

indicators.note: around tells us the stick is placed on either side of the other piece

parts.note: a cane is a walking stick
IN means at home, as in 'staying in'

explanation.surface: Someone who stays in with a walking stick, behaving like a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Canine is the adjective for things relating to or resembling dogs.

clue.text: May it be described as a trunk road?

definitions.text: May it be described as a trunk road?

parts.words: May it be described as a trunk road?
parts.note: a trunk road is a main highway, but here the trunks are of trees lining a road

explanation.surface: A question about whether a road counts as a main route.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a broad road lined with trees, so trunks flank it.

clue.text: Crazy about Mum, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: about means the first piece surrounds the second

parts.note: idiotic means crazy or foolish
Ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: In a way, you could say someone is mad about their mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatic describes language in the natural manner of native speakers.

clue.text: Point learnt afresh, always to be remembered

parts.note: E is a compass point, east

indicators.note: afresh means anew, so the letters are made up again in a new order

explanation.surface: A lesson learnt again is never forgotten.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternal means everlasting, lasting forever in memory.

clue.text: Diamond ring indicating one is unobtainable?

definitions.text: Diamond ring indicating one is unobtainable?

parts.words: Diamond ring indicating one is unobtainable?
parts.note: an engagement ring shows one is spoken for; also a telephone tone saying the line is busy

explanation.surface: A diamond ring that announces its wearer is off the market.
explanation.definitionFit: This telephone tone tells a caller the line is busy, so the person cannot be reached.

clue.text: Nymph who faded away normally comes back

definitions.meaning: in Greek myth the nymph pined for Narcissus until only her voice remained
a sound reflected off a surface returns to the listener

explanation.surface: A mythical nymph wasted away yet keeps returning.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: the mythical nymph and the reflected sound that returns.

clue.text: Fruit served by sergeant in mess

indicators.note: a mess is a jumble, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Small citrus fruit is handed out by a sergeant in the army mess hall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mess' looks like the military dining hall, but it signals the anagram of SERGEANT IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangerine is a kind of small citrus fruit, so it is an example of the category.

clue.text: Georgia admits relationship with Russian composer

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
a link is a connection or relationship

explanation.surface: Georgia acknowledges a connection with a composer from Russia.
explanation.definitionFit: Mikhail Glinka was a nineteenth-century composer, often called the father of Russian music.

clue.text: Only men go in at such a meeting

indicators.note: go in tells us the pieces are placed inside the word at

parts.note: but can mean only, as in 'all but'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gathering where only men are allowed to enter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go in' looks like admission to a meeting, but it puts the pieces inside 'at'; the definition plays on a structural meeting point, not a gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: An abutment is where two things meet or touch, a point of contact or junction.

clue.text: A witness taking no part in the proceedings

definitions.meaning: an onlooker who sees an event happen

definitions.text: taking no part in the proceedings
definitions.meaning: someone who watches without getting involved

explanation.surface: A witness who stays out of the court case.
explanation.definitionFit: A bystander is an onlooker present at an event but not participating in it.

clue.text: It's only fair the board should accept new role

indicators.note: should accept means take in, so the board goes around the other letters

parts.note: a table is a board, as in board and lodging

indicators.note: new tells us the word role is remade in a different order

explanation.surface: Fairness says a committee should agree to a fresh job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the word role, and 'the board' sounds like a committee, but it is furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolerable means acceptable but not great, merely middling.

clue.text: The others coming from Latin and elsewhere

definitions.meaning: Latin et alii, meaning and other people
Latin et alibi, meaning and in other places

explanation.surface: The rest of them derive from Latin and other places.
explanation.walkthrough: Both senses are abbreviations from Latin: et alii and et alibi.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin abbreviation expands to either et alii (and others) or et alibi (and elsewhere).

clue.text: Realise it's a trick

definitions.meaning: to realise an asset is to convert it into money by disposing of it
a dated colloquial word for a hoax or swindle

explanation.surface: Understand that it's a con.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Realise' suggests understanding, but it is used in its financial sense of turning into cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: converting goods to cash, and an old slang word for a con.

clue.text: Teaches fishes swimming

explanation.surface: Someone gives lessons to swimming fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: educating someone, and shoals of fish moving together.

clue.text: Raise cost somehow, or get cut off

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters arrive in some other way, an arrangement unspecified

explanation.surface: Push the price up somehow, or else find yourself disconnected.
explanation.definitionFit: To ostracise someone is to exclude them, cutting them off from a group.

clue.text: Denial of a fault in the show ring

definitions.text: a fault in the show ring
definitions.meaning: in showjumping a horse balking at a fence incurs penalty faults

explanation.surface: Refusing to admit a mistake at a horse show.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a rejection, and a horse balking at a jump in competition.

clue.text: Keep us up to the mark

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: a stain is a mark

explanation.surface: Help us stay up to standard.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain is to keep something going or maintain it.

clue.text: Second mate in ship of the line

indicators.note: in means this letter is placed inside the other word

parts.note: a liner is a large passenger ship

indicators.note: second means the second letter of the next word

explanation.surface: The second mate serves aboard a ship of the line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second' takes A, the second letter of 'mate'; a 'ship of the line' is a warship, but 'of the line' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Linear means relating to or arranged in a line.

clue.text: Delightful tea served with best china

parts.note: char is British slang for tea
Ming porcelain is the finest Chinese ware

explanation.surface: A lovely cup of tea is served in the finest porcelain.
explanation.definitionFit: Charming is a near synonym meaning very pleasant or attractive.

clue.text: Fragile copy

definitions.meaning: a thin carbon copy made on light paper

explanation.surface: A delicate duplicate.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: something weak and easily damaged, and thin paper used for duplicates.

clue.text: A piece of cake? But not to a pilot's liking

definitions.meaning: the sugary topping found on a cake
ice forming on aircraft wings is a hazard

explanation.surface: Something easy, yet a pilot dislikes it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A piece of cake' looks like the idiom for something easy; here it means part of a cake.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a cake's sugar coating, and ice building up on aircraft.

clue.text: Instrument requiring twice as much sound foundation

parts.note: double means twice as much

indicators.note: sound here means the word is spoken, giving a word that is heard the same

parts.note: a base is a foundation

explanation.surface: A musical instrument needs twice as solid a base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound foundation' reads as a firm base; instead BASE is said aloud, which gives BASS.
explanation.definitionFit: The double bass is the largest bowed string instrument of the orchestra.

clue.text: Country artist with an outstanding level of intelligence

indicators.note: outstanding is read as standing outside, so the measure goes around the artist

parts.note: IQ is the intelligence quotient
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of Britain's Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.surface: A nation whose painter is exceptionally clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' looks like praise for the artist, but it means standing outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Iraq is a country in the Middle East.

clue.text: Make a mistake and throw out the drink

indicators.note: out signals that the throw stands outside the mistake, enclosing it

parts.note: to shy is to throw, as in a coconut shy
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone blunders and tosses the drink away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Throw out' looks like a phrase meaning discard; split apart, 'out' says the throw goes around the mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherry is a fortified wine from Spain, a type of alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Hit on an advertising catch phrase

indicators.note: on means placed next to, so the second piece follows the first

parts.note: to slog is to hit hard

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles upon a catchy line for an advert.
explanation.definitionFit: A slogan is a memorable motto used in advertising.
